title: Decode with Odi at San Diego Central Library!
description:
Decodable books help children understand the sounds created by different letter combinations, and they can now be found at Central Library’s new “Decode with Odi” section!

Research shows this approach helps children decode words independently, strengthening both their confidence and foundational literacy skills.
 
The curated materials in this collection make it easy for families, educators and caregivers to find the books that match a child's stage of development: insidesandiego.org/san-diego-public-library-unveils-new-book-collection-encourage-early-readers
